subject: Argument/syntax for subgroup in multiple group cfa

messages.author: 56e14d36ffa830a3
messages.subject: Argument/syntax for subgroup in multiple group cfa
parts:
Dear Yves and Lavaanians,

What is the argument if you have subgroup during multiple group  CFA?  Eg, the main group is sex and subgroup within each sex categories is marital status. When I used this argument group=c("sex", "marriage"), this error was reported; 

"Error in if (warn && any(Mp[[g]]$coverage < 0.1)) { : 
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
In addition: Warning message:
In if (!(group %in% names(data))) { :
  the condition has length > 1 and only the first element will be used"

Kind regards,
Ashenafi

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Argument/syntax for subgroup in multiple group cfa
parts:
The "group" argument only accepts a single name of a column (vector) in your data.frame with grouping indicators.  If you need multiple grouping variables, then you need to create a single column that combines the "sex" and "marriage" information.  The quickest way would probably be to use the interaction() function:

?interaction
myData$sex.marriage <- interaction(myData$sex, myData$marriage)


Terry
